summary: Bion Environmental Technologies filed a Form 8-K on October 6, 2026, correcting an inaccurate statement in its September 29, 2026 Form 10-K that an engineering firm had been engaged by Bion and Kimmeridge for pilot testing and a FEL-3 study on a large RNG project. The company clarified that, as of both the annual report and current filing dates, it is negotiating but has not executed agreements with several engineering firms for pilot testing and FEL-2/3 services, with no assurance any agreement will be reached; other disclosures remain unaffected.
